description: Search the publisher network for editorial placements. Filter by price, Domain Authority, Domain Rating, category, region, turnaround and whether the outlet is Google-indexed or LLM-ready, link type and availability. Returns a page of matches, highest Domain Authority first by default. Each result carries the same fields as get_placement.

available.description: true for placements that can be ordered now, false for unavailable ones.

categories.description: Match any of these categories, e.g. ["Crypto", "Health"].

googleIndexed.description: Only outlets known to be indexed by Google.

linkFollow.description: Only placements with this linkAttributes value. Today the catalog records dofollow only; every other listing is "unspecified", so nofollow, sponsored and ugc match nothing yet.

llmReady.description: Only outlets flagged as readable by AI crawlers.

query.description: Free text matched against publication name, domain and categories.

region.description: Substring match on the outlet's region.

name: search_placements
title: Search placements
